data.name: 风之国世界
data.detailed_description:
This game is a fantasy style cultivation+MMORPG game, focusing on character development, pet matching, and guild territory confrontation. Players take forging and upgrading as the core growth line, unlocking diverse gameplay such as trials, hunting grounds, and secret realms. They combine three major professions and six schools with pets, demons, war souls, and elves to develop their combat power. They participate in guild territory wars to win the title of king, with a clear development route that balances leisure AFK and deep competitive experience. The core revolves around upgrading the forging of gold nuggets, unlocking resource dungeons such as the Trial Temple, Kingdom Hunting Ground, and Starry Sky Realm; Match professional genres with pets, demons, war souls, and elves to cultivate combat power; On the 6th day of the game, the territory war begins, and the guild declares war to compete for territory. At the end of the season, rewards are earned, and the president can receive exclusive honors and costumes such as Lord and King.

The main levels include the Trial Temple (unlocking high-level bosses with rich rewards for the first pass), Starry Sky Realm (unlocking and placing rewards and pet formations through push levels), Kingdom Hunting Ground (timed boss battles, damage ranking rewards), Treasure Hunt Secret Realm (automatic/manual resource collection, cross player exploration), and Adventure dungeons (2 team challenges per day, multiple difficulty levels, rich rewards), which gradually open according to the level.
